s0201.literal: A Ceremonial Protocol Office was established at fifth rank, with one director and one assistant each.
s0201.idiomatic: A Ceremonial Protocol Office was established at fifth rank, with one director and one assistant each.

s0202.literal: On yiwei day Princes Anhui, Aruhui, and Prince of Beining Dieleger Bukhua were granted three hundred fifty taels of gold and three thousand seven hundred taels of silver.
s0202.idiomatic: On yiwei day Princes Anhui, Aruhui, and Prince of Beining Dieleger Bukhua were granted 350 taels of gold and 3,700 taels of silver.

s0203.literal: Right Executioner Surveillance Censor Wubadula was made associate administrator of the central secretariat.
s0203.idiomatic: Right executioner surveillance censor Wubadula was made associate administrator of the central secretariat.

s0204.literal: On wuxu day Censor-in-Chief Toghto was enfeoffed Duke of Qin State.
s0204.idiomatic: On wuxu day censor-in-chief Toghto was enfeoffed Duke of Qin State.

s0205.literal: On xinchou day, for newly attached people in the far north, relay stations were set up to transport grain for famine relief.
s0205.idiomatic: On xinchou day, for newly attached people in the far north, relay stations were set up to transport grain for famine relief.

s0206.literal: On guimao day the Yeliqheya Garrison-Farm Office was changed to the Colony Transport Grain Ten-Thousand-Household Office.
s0206.idiomatic: On guimao day the Yeliqheya garrison-farm office was changed to the colony transport grain ten-thousand-household office.

s0207.literal: On jiachen day ten thousand shi of grain stored by Nalan Bula was used to relieve famine victims in the vicinity.
s0207.idiomatic: On jiachen day 10,000 shi of grain stored by Nalan Bula was used to relieve famine victims in the vicinity.

s0208.literal: On bingwu day a Buddha pavilion was built at Wutai Monastery.
s0208.idiomatic: On bingwu day a Buddha pavilion was built at Wutai Monastery.

s0209.literal: Jiangnan suffered famine; confiscated-fine notes stored by the ten circuits' surveillance commissions were used for relief.
s0209.idiomatic: Jiangnan suffered famine; confiscated-fine notes stored by the ten circuits' surveillance commissions were used for relief.

s0210.literal: On jiyou day, acceding to the Crown Prince's request, the Crown Prince Household Court was raised to second rank, and deliberating and adjudicating officials were established as in the privy council.
s0210.idiomatic: On jiyou day, acceding to the crown prince's request, the crown prince household court was raised to second rank, and deliberating and adjudicating officials were established as in the privy council.

s0211.literal: On xinhai day Right Vice Chancellor Boluo Temür presented a translation of the Classic of Filial Piety in 'Phags-pa script; an edict said: "These are Confucius's subtle teachings; from kings and dukes down to commoners, all should follow this path.
s0211.idiomatic: On xinhai day right vice chancellor Boluo Temür presented a translation of the Classic of Filial Piety in 'Phags-pa script; an edict said, "These are Confucius's subtle teachings; from kings and dukes down to commoners, all should follow this path.

s0212.literal: He ordered the central secretariat to carve blocks and print copies, granting them to all from princes downward.
s0212.idiomatic: He ordered the central secretariat to carve blocks and print copies, granting them to all from princes downward.

s0213.literal: " On guichou day the Tangut tulughun army lacked provisions; grain was issued for relief.
s0213.idiomatic: " On guichou day the Tangut tulughun army lacked provisions; grain was issued for relief.

s0214.literal: On bingchen day the Relics Custodian Office was raised to third rank.
s0214.idiomatic: On bingchen day the relics custodian office was raised to third rank.

s0215.literal: On dingsi day Left Vice Chancellor Wang Shou was made vice censor-in-chief.
s0215.idiomatic: On dingsi day left vice chancellor Wang Shou was made vice censor-in-chief.

s0216.literal: On wuwu day Central Secretariat Grand Councillors Qitai Puji, Chuangwu'er, and Biebuhua were all given the Grand Marshal title; Right Vice Chancellor Tahai was given Grand Marshal and made grand councillor; Left Vice Chancellor Boluo Temür was made right vice chancellor.
s0216.idiomatic: On wuwu day central secretariat grand councillors Qitai Puji, Chuangwu'er, and Biebuhua were all given the grand marshal title; right vice chancellor Tahai was given grand marshal and made grand councillor; left vice chancellor Boluo Temür was made right vice chancellor.

s0217.literal: Dongchang, Bianliang, Tangzhou, Yan'an, Tan, Yuan, Gui, Li, and Xingguo circuits suffered famine; grain was issued for relief.
s0217.idiomatic: Dongchang, Bianliang, Tangzhou, Yan'an, Tan, Yuan, Gui, Li, and Xingguo circuits suffered famine; grain was issued for relief.

s0218.literal: Jining Route suffered earthquake; Hejian, Zhending, and other prefectures had locusts; Longping, Wenshui, Pingyao, Qi, Huoyi, Jinghai, Rongcheng, and Shulu counties had flooding.
s0218.idiomatic: Jining Route suffered earthquake; Hejian, Zhending, and other prefectures had locusts; Longping, Wenshui, Pingyao, Qi, Huoyi, Jinghai, Rongcheng, and Shulu counties had flooding.

s0219.literal: Ninth month, jiazi day: the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
s0219.idiomatic: Ninth month, jiazi day: the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.

s0220.literal: On yichou day posthumous titles for the Emperor's late father and the late reigning emperor were requested at the Southern Suburb; Right Chancellor Talahai was ordered to act as Grand Marshal and conduct the ceremony.
s0220.idiomatic: On yichou day posthumous titles for the emperor's late father and the late reigning emperor were requested at the Southern Suburb; right chancellor Talahai was ordered to act as grand marshal and conduct the ceremony.

s0221.literal: On gengwu day the Censorate was raised to second rank.
s0221.idiomatic: On gengwu day the censorate was raised to second rank.

s0222.literal: On xinwei day Talahai and Tasibuhua were both given the Grand Marshal title.
s0222.idiomatic: On xinwei day Talahai and Tasibuhua were both given the grand marshal title.

s0223.literal: On renshen day Talahai was ordered to present jade books and jade seals, conferring honorific posthumous names and temple names on the Emperor's late father and the late reigning emperor; honorific posthumous names were also conferred on the former primary consort of the Hongjira clan, who was enshrined in Chengzong's temple chamber.
s0223.idiomatic: On renshen day Talahai was ordered to present jade books and jade seals, conferring honorific posthumous names and temple names on the emperor's late father and the late reigning emperor; honorific posthumous names were also conferred on the former primary consort of the Hongjira clan, who was enshrined in Chengzong's temple chamber.

s0224.literal: The Hostelry Directorate was raised to proper third rank.
s0224.idiomatic: The hostelry directorate was raised to proper third rank.

s0225.literal: On guiyou day Venus transgressed the Right Enforcer.
s0225.idiomatic: On guiyou day Venus transgressed the Right Enforcer.

s0226.literal: On jiaxu day the Court of Imperial Sacrifices was changed to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ceremonies, proper second rank.
s0226.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the Court of Imperial Sacrifices was changed to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ceremonies, proper second rank.

s0227.literal: The Ceremonial Attendance Office was raised to proper third rank.
s0227.idiomatic: The ceremonial attendance office was raised to proper third rank.

s0228.literal: On bingzi day the Crown Prince's Stud Directorate was established, proper third rank.
s0228.idiomatic: On bingzi day the crown prince's stud directorate was established, proper third rank.

s0229.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "For appointment regulations within and without, there was formerly an edict to follow Shizu's established system entirely.
s0229.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "For appointment regulations within and without, there was formerly an edict to follow Shizu's established system entirely.

s0230.literal: Promotions of close attendants of both palaces were matters ordered by the emperor.
s0230.idiomatic: Promotions of close attendants of both palaces were matters ordered by the emperor.

s0231.literal: Recently there have been those who ought to enter regular appointment but have, through connections, been abruptly promoted;
s0231.idiomatic: Recently there have been those who ought to enter regular appointment but have, through connections, been abruptly promoted;

s0232.literal: those already in office who were dismissed and demoted, and those who had never entered office, likewise again requested edicts from the inner palace.
s0232.idiomatic: those already in office who were dismissed and demoted, and those who had never entered office, likewise again requested edicts from the inner palace.

s0233.literal: We memorialized requesting prohibition, and were granted approval.
s0233.idiomatic: We memorialized requesting prohibition, and were granted approval.

s0234.literal: After this, inner-palace edicts still numbered more than a hundred; we have already selected and carried them out.
s0234.idiomatic: After this, inner-palace edicts still numbered more than 100; we have already selected and carried them out.

s0235.literal: But central secretariat government affairs — when others can again request at will, holding us responsible for rectification — the effect is truly hard to achieve.
s0235.idiomatic: But central secretariat government affairs — when others can again request at will, holding us responsible for rectification — the effect is truly hard to achieve.

s0236.literal: From now on for appointments and money-grain affairs, we request following the former system: what has not been deliberated by the central secretariat must not be memorialized over authority.
s0236.idiomatic: From now on for appointments and money-grain affairs, we request following the former system: what has not been deliberated by the central secretariat must not be memorialized over authority.

s0238.literal: They further said: "Recently Qielai Muding presented precious goods; an edict granted him ten thousand salt certificates, still permitting him to trade for ninety thousand certificates.
s0238.idiomatic: They further said, "Recently Qielai Muding presented precious goods; an edict granted him 10,000 salt certificates, still permitting him to trade for 90,000 certificates.

s0239.literal: We privately consider: the precious goods traded, their price having been assessed, should receive only notes in payment; if certificates are given, it will only harm the salt law.
s0239.idiomatic: We privately consider: the precious goods traded, their price having been assessed, should receive only notes in payment; if certificates are given, it will only harm the salt law.

s0240.literal: " The Emperor said: "This I spoke of myself, not at officials' request; grant it — do not take the rest as precedent.
s0240.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "This I spoke of myself, not at officials' request; grant it — do not take the rest as precedent.

s0241.literal: " Jiang-Zhe suffered famine; central secretariat officials said: "We request ordering this province's official rent — in ninth month advance one third of payment, to prepare for relief distribution.
s0241.idiomatic: " Jiang-Zhe suffered famine; central secretariat officials said, "We request ordering this province's official rent — in ninth month advance one third of payment, to prepare for relief distribution.

s0242.literal: Further, the grain transport canals of Liang-Huai were silted; the government deliberated dredging, collecting two guan in notes per salt certificate as labor fees, totaling twenty-eight thousand ingots; now the river is open, and these funds should be redirected to relieve famine victims.
s0242.idiomatic: Further, the grain transport canals of Liang-Huai were silted; the government deliberated dredging, collecting two guan in notes per salt certificate as labor fees, totaling 28,000 ingots; now the river is open, and these funds should be redirected to relieve famine victims.

s0243.literal: Hangzhou circuit alone annually consumes two hundred eighty thousand shi of rice and wheat for wine; prohibition would be advantageous.
s0243.idiomatic: Hangzhou circuit alone annually consumes 280,000 shi of rice and wheat for wine; prohibition would be advantageous.

s0244.literal: Henan, Yidu, and other circuits should also prohibit it.
s0244.idiomatic: Henan, Yidu, and other circuits should also prohibit it.

s0246.literal: Talahai said: "Recently receiving the sage grace, I was granted one hundred qing of Jiangnan farmland.
s0246.idiomatic: Talahai said, "Recently receiving the sage grace, I was granted 100 qing of Jiangnan farmland.

s0247.literal: Now that princes, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law are returning granted farmland to the government, we request returning what was granted to us.
s0247.idiomatic: Now that princes, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law are returning granted farmland to the government, we request returning what was granted to us.

s0249.literal: An instruction still announced that all persons' granted farmland was to be returned to the government.
s0249.idiomatic: An instruction still announced that all persons' granted farmland was to be returned to the government.

s0250.literal: Zhang Liursun was ordered to oversee Academy of Scholarly Worthies affairs and supervise Daoist affairs in all circuits.
s0250.idiomatic: Zhang Liursun was ordered to oversee Academy of Scholarly Worthies affairs and supervise Daoist affairs in all circuits.

s0251.literal: On dingchou day central secretariat officials said: "Recently when provincial member numbers were deliberated, an edict ordered fixing them at twelve per the former system: Right Chancellor Talahai, Left Chancellor Tasibuhua, grand councillors Chuangwu'er and Qitai Puji as before — the remainder leave us to deliberate.
s0251.idiomatic: On dingchou day central secretariat officials said, "Recently when provincial member numbers were deliberated, an edict ordered fixing them at 12 per the former system: right chancellor Talahai, left chancellor Tasibuhua, grand councillors Chuangwu'er and Qitai Puji as before — the remainder leave us to deliberate.

s0252.literal: We request Ashabuhua and Tashihaiya as grand councillors, Boluo Dash and Liu Zheng as right vice chancellors, Hao Tianting and Yesi Temuer as left vice chancellors, and Yu Zhang and Wubadula as associate administrators.
s0252.idiomatic: We request Ashabuhua and Tashihaiya as grand councillors, Boluo Dash and Liu Zheng as right vice chancellors, Hao Tianting and Yesi Temuer as left vice chancellors, and Yu Zhang and Wubadula as associate administrators.

s0253.literal: Redundant posts in all agencies attending court should also be screened and culled.
s0253.idiomatic: Redundant posts in all agencies attending court should also be screened and culled.

s0255.literal: On jimao day Venus transgressed the Left Enforcer.
s0255.idiomatic: On jimao day Venus transgressed the Left Enforcer.

s0256.literal: On renwu day the Court of Imperial Studs was changed to the Court of the Imperial Guard, second rank.
s0256.idiomatic: On renwu day the Court of Imperial Studs was changed to the Court of the Imperial Guard, second rank.

s0257.literal: On jiashen day an edict ordered establishing the Ministry of Revenue to manage finances separately.
s0257.idiomatic: On jiashen day an edict ordered establishing the Ministry of Revenue to manage finances separately.

s0258.literal: Talahai and Tasibuhua were ordered to continue overseeing the central secretariat.
s0258.idiomatic: Talahai and Tasibuhua were ordered to continue overseeing the central secretariat.

s0259.literal: Tuohuotuo, Jiaohua, and Fahur al-Din were put in charge of the Ministry of Revenue, still permitting them to select their own subordinates; casting of the Ministry of Revenue seal was ordered.
s0259.idiomatic: Tuohuotuo, Jiaohua, and Fahur al-Din were put in charge of the Ministry of Revenue, still permitting them to select their own subordinates; casting of the Ministry of Revenue seal was ordered.

s0260.literal: An edict relaxed prohibitions on mountains and marshes in Jiang-Zhe circuits.
s0260.idiomatic: An edict relaxed prohibitions on mountains and marshes in Jiang-Zhe circuits.

s0261.literal: On bingxu day the Audience Office was raised to third rank.
s0261.idiomatic: On bingxu day the audience office was raised to third rank.

s0262.literal: The Crown Prince built a Buddhist monastery and requested purchasing private land to expand it; more than ten thousand seven hundred ingots of notes were granted.
s0262.idiomatic: The crown prince built a Buddhist monastery and requested purchasing private land to expand it; more than 10,700 ingots of notes were granted.

s0263.literal: On wuzi day the Yanqing Office was raised to second rank.
s0263.idiomatic: On wuzi day the Yanqing Office was raised to second rank.

s0264.literal: On jichou day envoys were dispatched to review prisoners.
s0264.idiomatic: On jichou day envoys were dispatched to review prisoners.

s0265.literal: Prince of Jin Yesun Temuer spoke on being granted ten thousand ingots by edict but receiving only eight thousand; central secretariat officials said: "The treasury is empty; regular revenue is four million ingots annually — beyond each province's reserves, what enters the capital is two million eight hundred thousand ingots; what is normally expended is only two million seven hundred thousand-odd ingots.
s0265.idiomatic: Prince of Jin Yesun Temuer spoke on being granted 10,000 ingots by edict but receiving only 8,000; central secretariat officials said, "The treasury is empty; regular revenue is 4 million ingots annually — beyond each province's reserves, what enters the capital is 2.8 million ingots; what is normally expended is only 2.7 million-odd ingots.

s0266.literal: Since Your Majesty's accession, four million two hundred thousand ingots have already been expended, and one million ingots requested but not yet paid remain outstanding.
s0266.idiomatic: Since Your Majesty's accession, 4.2 million ingots have already been expended, and 1 million ingots requested but not yet paid remain outstanding.

s0267.literal: We fear finances insufficient and venture to report this.
s0267.idiomatic: We fear finances insufficient and venture to report this.

s0268.literal: " The Emperor said: "What you say is correct.
s0268.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "What you say is correct.

s0269.literal: From now grants should temporarily cease; no one may memorialize requests.
s0269.idiomatic: From now grants should temporarily cease; no one may memorialize requests.

s0270.literal: One thousand ingots may be given to the Prince of Jin; the remainder transfer to Shaanxi Province for payment.
s0270.idiomatic: 1,000 ingots may be given to the Prince of Jin; the remainder transfer to Shaanxi Province for payment.

s0271.literal: " Associate Grand Councillor Biebuhua was made Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat grand councillor.
s0271.idiomatic: Associate grand councillor Biebuhua was made Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor.

s0272.literal: On xinmao day censorate officials said: "In the Zhiyuan period Ahmad managed finances and established the Ministry of Revenue; after three years it was merged into the central secretariat.
s0272.idiomatic: On xinmao day censorate officials said, "In the Zhiyuan period Ahmad managed finances and established the Ministry of Revenue; after three years it was merged into the central secretariat.

s0273.literal: Afterwards Sangge held power, re-established the Ministry of Revenue, and after his fall it was again merged into the central secretariat.
s0273.idiomatic: Afterwards Sangge held power, re-established the Ministry of Revenue, and after his fall it was again merged into the central secretariat.

s0274.literal: Since Dade year 5, earthquakes and floods have struck in all directions, harvests still fail, and the people are heavily distressed; policies to benefit the people are urgently needed today.
s0274.idiomatic: Since Dade year 5, earthquakes and floods have struck in all directions, harvests still fail, and the people are heavily distressed; policies to benefit the people are urgently needed today.

s0275.literal: Recently we again hear of establishing the Ministry of Revenue to manage finances comprehensively; if so, offices must surely be added and officials recklessly appointed — scarcely a matter that benefits the people.
s0275.idiomatic: Recently we again hear of establishing the Ministry of Revenue to manage finances comprehensively; if so, offices must surely be added and officials recklessly appointed — scarcely a matter that benefits the people.

s0276.literal: Moreover, managing finances depends on men; if only the central secretariat were ordered to rectify matters, we see no reason this would fail.
s0276.idiomatic: Moreover, managing finances depends on men; if only the central secretariat were ordered to rectify matters, we see no reason this would fail.

s0277.literal: Were we to conceal our views, we fear we would incur guilt.
s0277.idiomatic: Were we to conceal our views, we fear we would incur guilt.

s0278.literal: " The Emperor said: "What you say is quite right.
s0278.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "What you say is quite right.

s0279.literal: These three officials wish to undertake the matter; for now let them proceed.
s0279.idiomatic: These three officials wish to undertake the matter; for now let them proceed.

s0280.literal: " That month, Xiangyang had continuous rain and the people suffered famine; Henan Province was ordered to issue grain for relief.
s0280.idiomatic: That month, Xiangyang had continuous rain and the people suffered famine; Henan Province was ordered to issue grain for relief.

s0281.literal: Tenth month, yiwei day: the Treasures Custodian Office was raised to the Treasures Custodian Directorate, proper third rank.
s0281.idiomatic: Tenth month, yiwei day: the treasures custodian office was raised to the treasures custodian directorate, proper third rank.

s0282.literal: On gengzi day the central secretariat memorialized: "When the central secretariat was first established, Grand Preceptor Liu Bingzhong surveyed the site for suitability; Yuzong served as central secretariat director and once came to the secretariat offices to instruct.
s0282.idiomatic: On gengzi day the central secretariat memorialized, "When the central secretariat was first established, grand preceptor Liu Bingzhong surveyed the site for suitability; Yuzong served as central secretariat director and once came to the secretariat offices to instruct.

s0283.literal: Afterwards Sangge relocated and established the Ministry of Revenue; within four years it was abolished.
s0283.idiomatic: Afterwards Sangge relocated and established the Ministry of Revenue; within four years it was abolished.

s0284.literal: Now the central secretariat is again moved to the former offices; we request an auspicious day to reposition the central secretariat director's seat, and also request the Crown Prince come once to the central secretariat.
s0284.idiomatic: Now the central secretariat is again moved to the former offices; we request an auspicious day to reposition the central secretariat director's seat, and also request the crown prince come once to the central secretariat.

s0286.literal: On renyin day the Auspicious Insignia Directorate was raised to the Auspicious Insignia Office, second rank.
s0286.idiomatic: On renyin day the auspicious insignia directorate was raised to the auspicious insignia office, second rank.

s0287.literal: Privy Council Administrator Chuangwu'er was enfeoffed Duke of Rong State.
s0287.idiomatic: Privy council administrator Chuangwu'er was enfeoffed Duke of Rong State.

s0288.literal: On guimao day, per the former system wherein princes' and imperial sons-in-law's affairs were all overseen by inner-palace chief ministers, Right Vice Chancellor Boluo Temür was ordered to oversee them.
s0288.idiomatic: On guimao day, per the former system wherein princes' and imperial sons-in-law's affairs were all overseen by inner-palace chief ministers, right vice chancellor Boluo Temür was ordered to oversee them.

s0289.literal: On yisi day Venus transgressed Kang.
s0289.idiomatic: On yisi day Venus transgressed Kang.

s0290.literal: An edict ordered geomancers and day-selectors not to visit the gates of princes and imperial sons-in-law.
s0290.idiomatic: An edict ordered geomancers and day-selectors not to visit the gates of princes and imperial sons-in-law.

s0291.literal: On bingwu day an edict ordered rectification of censorate discipline, announced within and without.
s0291.idiomatic: On bingwu day an edict ordered rectification of censorate discipline, announced within and without.

s0292.literal: Censor-in-Chief Tiegudie'er was enfeoffed Duke of Yun State; Central Guard Personal Army Commander Mainu was made privy council administrator.
s0292.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Tiegudie'er was enfeoffed Duke of Yun State; Central Guard personal army commander Mainu was made privy council administrator.

s0293.literal: On renzi day, acceding to central secretariat officials, wherever matters bypass the central secretariat and envoys or joint documents are dispatched at will — this was prohibited.
s0293.idiomatic: On renzi day, acceding to central secretariat officials, wherever matters bypass the central secretariat and envoys or joint documents are dispatched at will — this was prohibited.

s0294.literal: On jiayin day the Moon transgressed Bright Hall.
s0294.idiomatic: On jiayin day the moon transgressed Bright Hall.

s0295.literal: The Academy of Scholarly Worthies was raised to first rank; the Construction Directorate was raised to second rank.
s0295.idiomatic: The Academy of Scholarly Worthies was raised to first rank; the Construction Directorate was raised to second rank.

s0296.literal: On bingchen day branch secretariat grand councillors overseeing military horses were permitted tiger tallies; those worn by left vice chancellors and others were all recovered.
s0296.idiomatic: On bingchen day branch secretariat grand councillors overseeing military horses were permitted tiger tallies; those worn by left vice chancellors and others were all recovered.

s0297.literal: The central secretariat memorialized: "Annually sea transport grain is one million four hundred fifty thousand shi; now Jiang-Zhe's harvest is poor and cannot meet the quota; we request following the former precedent — Huguang and Jiangxi each supply five hundred thousand shi, all reaching the capital by sea route.
s0297.idiomatic: The central secretariat memorialized, "Annually sea transport grain is 1.45 million shi; now Jiang-Zhe's harvest is poor and cannot meet the quota; we request following the former precedent — Huguang and Jiangxi each supply 500,000 shi, all reaching the capital by sea route.

s0299.literal: On jiwei day Tasibuhua memorialized on government affairs and also resigned the Grand Marshal post, returning the conferred commission and seal.
s0299.idiomatic: On jiwei day Tasibuhua memorialized on government affairs and also resigned the grand marshal post, returning the conferred commission and seal.

s0300.literal: That month, Hangzhou and Pingjiang had flooding; the people suffered famine; grain was issued for relief.
s0300.idiomatic: That month, Hangzhou and Pingjiang had flooding; the people suffered famine; grain was issued for relief.
